name: Overlord Mok'Morokk
summary: Brackenwall Village is where Overlord Mok'Morokk rules the Stonemaul ogres of Dustwallow Marsh. Rexxar chose him for his strength, but now he is a tyrant who will not defend his clan from the black dragonflight.

sections.title: A Tyrant in the Marsh
sections.body: Rexxar defeated Kor'gall, the former chieftain, and led the Stonemaul clan in defense of Durotar. When he left, he put Mok'Morokk in command, trusting his strength in battle. He was wrong to trust him. Mok'Morokk chose intimidation and comfort over care for his kin. From Brackenwall Village, he demands tribute he has not earned and bullies anyone who questions his rule.

sections.title: The Coward of Brackenwall
sections.body: The black dragonflight descended on ancestral Stonemaul Village. Many ogres died, and the survivors were driven into Brackenwall's muck. Mok'Morokk forbade his clan to act. Fear of the dragons kept him from rallying a counterattack or avenging the dead. His advisers have grown discontent. Draz'Zilb, an ogre mage, and others quietly seek champions from beyond the clan to challenge Mok'Morokk's rule.

faq.answer: Mok'Morokk rules the Stonemaul ogres from Brackenwall Village in Dustwallow Marsh. Rexxar named him leader, but he soon grew selfish and demanding.

faq.q: How did Mok'Morokk become leader of the Stonemaul clan?
aliases: how did mok'morokk get in charge
faq.answer: Rexxar defeated the Stonemaul clan's former leader and took command during the founding of Durotar. When Rexxar left to wander the wilderness, he appointed Mok'Morokk overlord for his raw physical strength.

faq.q: Why are the Stonemaul ogres in Brackenwall Village?
aliases: why did ogres move to brackenwall
faq.answer: The Stonemaul ogres lived in Stonemaul Village until black dragons attacked and razed it. The survivors fled north into the swamps and made Brackenwall Village their refuge.

faq.q: Why won't Mok'Morokk fight the black dragonflight?
faq.answer: Mok'Morokk is terrified of the dragons despite his size and fierce reputation. He refuses to lead a counterattack for his clan's ancestral territory. Instead, he sits idle in Brackenwall, hoards tribute, and ignores his people's cries.

faq.q: Do the other Stonemaul ogres respect Mok'Morokk?
faq.answer: The Stonemaul clan grows resentful of Mok'Morokk's laziness, cowardice, and bullying. His advisers worry about the clan's future under his rule.

angles.text: Rexxar's campaign brought the Stonemaul ogres into alliance with the Horde. Under Mok'Morokk's weak and cowardly rule, Brackenwall Village is vulnerable.
As a warrior, Mok'Morokk shows how strength without honor or courage can turn to cowardice and tyranny.
